messages:
Alex: Quick handoff from me — overnight update and actions. I paged at 02:12 UTC via oncall-bot for a KV eviction spike affecting embeddings backpressure. Main points: customer impact limited to higher p95 for embeddings in eu-west for ~18m, no data loss.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT [P1] 02:12 UTC - kv-cache-evictions-high - paging Alex (primary). Link: https://redwood.ops/incident/1749997777 :rotating_light:

Alex: Timeline: 02:12 alerts; 02:15 identified autoscaler oscillation causing eviction storms; 02:22 applied temporary throttling to embedding autoscaler (policy id `autoscaler-temp-429`); 02:30 rolled forward a rate-limit bump on eu-west ingress to reduce fan-in.

Maria: Echo — I was on-call backup. Confirmed the autoscaler was triggering due to a noisy tenant that sent a batch-heavy workload. Took a copy of the offending trace: `trace/ew-2026-04-05-02-18.json`.

Kevin: Throttling helped p95 but p99 remained noisy until we backfilled cache region leader at 02:45. Backfill command used: 
```bash
./scripts/cache_rebalance --region eu-west --leader backfill --max-retries 3
```
Result: leaders rebalance completed 02:49, evictions dropped to baseline by ~02:55.

Priya: Customer impact log (CS events): 3 customers reported delayed embeddings jobs via support tickets. No SLA breaches recorded; we proactively sent an incident note. CS tag `cs-notify/1749997777` used.

oncall-bot: POST-MORTEM NOTE: Runbook used: /runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler-thrash. Actions recommended flagged to follow-ups.

Alex: Current status as of last check (02:53): all metrics stable in eu-west, autoscaler set to conservative profile `scaling-lock-2026-04-05`. No more pages since 02:30.

Maria: Coverage/ownership for next shift: Primary = Kevin, Secondary = Priya (agreed). Kevin, you have the bridge if anything recurs.

Kevin: Got it, taking primary. Quick checklist I ran:
- Confirmed autoscaler policy pinned
- Verified KV eviction rate < threshold
- Confirmed ingress rate-limiter active
- Updated dashboards to show tenant `tenant-id: noisy-42` spike panel

Priya: Noting a small coverage gap: EU-night SRE rotations are light between 03:00-05:00 UTC. If Kevin gets paged, Maria will join on immediate cadence since she's awake til 04:00 UTC. After that, escalation to on-call manager.

Alex: Follow-ups (owner, ETA):
- Kevin: remove noisy tenant from autoscale bucket and add hard rate cap (ETA EOD).
- Maria: prepare a short runbook appendix for tenant misbehaviour (ETA 24h).
- Alex: schedule post-incident review and include cost impact estimate for extra autoscale cycles (ETA 48h).

Kevin: I'll open a tracking ticket: https://redwood.tracker/ISSUE-4578 and add links to metrics snapshots, traces, and the backfill command output.

Maria: For the next 24h we should keep `scaling-lock-2026-04-05` active and monitor embedding p95/p99; I'll set an alert for >2x baseline.

Alex: Runbook pointers for whoever picks this up:
- Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler-thrash
- Quick mitigation snippet (use when seeing eviction > 300/s):
```yaml
actions:
  - set-autoscaler-profile: conservative
  - apply-ingress-throttle: tenant noisy-42 -> 20req/s
  - rebalance-cache-leaders: region eu-west
```

oncall-bot: REMINDER: please annotate the incident with `postmortem:required` if customer-impact > 0.

Priya: Minor note — we should add a dashboard tile showing `per-tenant batching volume` so noisy tenants surface earlier. Adding to sprint backlog.

Alex: Closing handoff: primary/secondary confirmed (Kevin/Priya), system stable, follow-ups assigned. If anything flares, ping `#eng-oncall` and page Kevin. :thumbsup:

Kevin: Acknowledged, I'm on it.

Maria: Thanks all, good catch.

Priya: Night team, I'll monitor the next hour and escalate if needed.

Alex: End of thread.
